verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitwarden generates TOTP codes in its integrated authenticator and that a separate Authenticator app can optionally be connected to Password Manager for sync. Nothing documents that codes are generated with no network connection, or that they can be viewed without a Bitwarden account. Treating sync as 'optional' is an inference, not documented offline or account-free operation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes
